# INICIO

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
library(corrplot)
library(GGally)
library(MVN)
```

# Datos Escalados

```{r}
df_centro = read.csv("DATASET_CENTRO_LIMPIO2")
df_norte = read.csv("DATASET_NORTE_LIMPIO2")

names <- c("X","Fecha_y_hora","CO","NO","NO2","NOX","O3","PM10","PM25","PRS","RAINF","RH","SO2","SR",
           "TOUT","WSR","WDR")

df_centro <- scale(df_centro)
df_norte <- scale(df_norte)

df_centro <- as.data.frame(df_centro)
df_norte <- as.data.frame(df_norte)

names(df_centro) <- names
names(df_norte) <- names
```

# CENTRO

## Part 1: Baseline Full Model
1. Build the full multiple regression model

```{r}
model_ce <- lm(cbind(CO, NO, NO2, NOX, O3, PM10, PM25, SO2) ~ PRS + RAINF + RH + SR + TOUT + WSR + WDR, data = df_centro)

summary(model_ce)
```

## Part 2: Forward and Backward Selection

### CO
```{r}
data <- df_centro[, c("CO",
                      "PRS","RAINF","RH","SR","TOUT","WSR","WDR")]

null_model <- lm(CO ~ 1, data = data)
full_model <- lm(CO ~ ., data = data)

model_forward <- step(null_model,
                      scope = formula(full_model),
                      direction = "forward",
                      trace = TRUE)

summary(model_forward)

model_backward <- step(full_model,
                       direction = "backward",
                       trace = TRUE)
summary(model_backward)
```

# Centro O3

```{r}
model_ce_o3 <- lm(O3 ~ PRS + RAINF + RH + SR + TOUT + WSR + WDR, data = df_centro)

summary(model_ce_o3)
```

# Test

```{r}
ggpairs(df_centro[, c(10:12 , 14:17)], title = "Correlation matrix with graphs")
```

```{r}
corrplot(cor(df_centro[, c(10:12 , 14:17)]), method = "color", type = "upper", tl.cex = 0.8)
```

```{r}
plot(model_ce_o3,which=1,lwd=3)
```

```{r}
plot(model_ce_o3,which=2)
```

```{r}
plot(model_ce_o3,which=3,lwd=3)
```

```{r}
plot(model_ce_o3,which=5,lwd=3)
```
